They have no clear definition or measurement method (e.g., a specific wait-time-at-pickup metric or a survey score).","evidence_quote":"Driver happiness: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Replace with glossary-defined metrics, such as driver wait time at pickup or pickup dwell time, and a defined driver satisfaction score."},{"type":"NO_BASELINE_TARGET","title":"No baseline, numeric target, or timeframe","detail":"Both success metrics say only \"improve\", with no baseline value, numeric target, or timeframe for achieving it.","evidence_quote":"Faster handoffs: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"State the current baseline, a numeric target (e.g., reduce median pickup wait from X to Y minutes), and the time window for evaluation."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Guardrails incomplete for pickup/dispatch behavior","detail":"The only guardrail is Cost Per Delivery, with no numeric threshold. A change that affects driver pickup timing and handoffs needs guardrails such as delivery time/lateness, order cancellation or driver decline rate, and food quality or temperature.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as on-time delivery rate, driver order decline/cancel rate, and delivery time, each with explicit thresholds."}]}
